verdict.rationale: Glama's reference page describes searching its curated catalog of servers and connectors, inspecting their capabilities, and keeping a directory synchronized, which suggests a documented programmatic registry API. An llms.txt index of the directory also exists. However, the evidence never shows endpoints, auth, or query parameters, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. missing for 10: concrete endpoint/schema documentation, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, tool-level discovery detail, hands-on corroboration of agent queries.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the platform's registry or catalog through a documented API to discover servers and tools programmatically

citations.quote: Search Glama's curated catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors, inspect their capabilities, and keep your own directory synchronized.
A directory of 91,626 Model Context Protocol servers and 23,749 remote connectors
